negative_findings.description: No search result surfaced any ready-made, sector-filtered view of Ukrainian treasury spending on banking equipment (ATMs, POS terminals, processing services). E-data/Spending and Prozorro expose generic transaction and contract layers only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-language coverage of E-data explicitly contained nothing about payment terminals or ATM vendors; Ukrainian searches likewise returned only generic portal/API material.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any banking-hardware intelligence from this cell must be constructed by us via CPV-code and payment-purpose keyword filters; there is no off-the-shelf sectoral dataset to subscribe to.

negative_findings.description: The spending.gov.ua transactions API endpoint (api.spending.gov.ua/api/v2/api/transactions/) and the contracts endpoint were reported in search snippets and third-party docs, not confirmed by a direct fetch in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Endpoint paths recorded from secondary references; exact base path, versioning and required parameters remain to be confirmed against the official Confluence manual.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Building a collector on an unverified path risks silent failure; the deterministic liveness pass and a read of the Confluence API manual should precede implementation.

negative_findings.description: State-owned commercial banks (Oschadbank, PrivatBank) buy ATMs/POS through Prozorro but are not budget holders paying via the State Treasury, so their contract execution is largely invisible in spending.gov.ua transaction data.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank buyer profiles appear on Prozorro mirrors; no evidence found of their payments in treasury transaction data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most commercially relevant Ukrainian ATM/POS buyers may only be traceable through Prozorro contracts and contract-execution reports, not the treasury 'money moved' layer — this limits the ground-truth claim for the bank segment.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Ukrainian-language register was found for post-award service/maintenance performance (SLA fulfilment) of banking equipment beyond the generic 'звіт про виконання договору' report in Prozorro.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on service maintenance of ATMs returned only generic procurement-control material.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recurring maintenance revenue must be inferred from repeating treasury payments to the same payee, not from an explicit service register.

coverage_gaps.description: No EDRPOU-code list yet exists for banking-equipment vendors and integrators active in Ukraine, which is the join key across spending.gov.ua, Prozorro and Clarity Project.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a vendor EDRPOU dictionary (Printec UA, NCR/NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Ingenico/PAX distributors, local integrators) from YouControl/Opendatabot/Clarity, then drive all payment queries from it.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV/ДК 021:2015 codes covering ATMs, POS terminals, cash-handling machines and their maintenance were not enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the relevant ДК 021:2015 code set and use it as the primary filter on Prozorro contracting feeds and BI Prozorro exports.

coverage_gaps.description: Local/municipal budget execution portals and communal enterprises (also E-data disposers) were not explored separately, though municipalities and communal utilities buy payment-acceptance infrastructure.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend a later pass to openbudget local-budget modules and disposer directories at oblast/hromada level.

coverage_gaps.description: Martial-law era restrictions on publication of certain procurement and spending data were not assessed; some transactions and buyers may be hidden or delayed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review current CMU resolutions on procurement disclosure during martial law and record known blind spots as data caveats.

coverage_gaps.description: Opendatabot and YouContract/YouControl were referenced only indirectly; their contract and treasury-payment products were not evaluated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess Opendatabot and YouControl API pricing and coverage of treasury transactions as commercial fallbacks to state APIs.

brief: Ukraine's contract-execution layer is unusually rich and rests on two state pillars: the Ministry of Finance E-data ecosystem (spending.gov.ua treasury transactions plus its contracts API, openbudget.gov.ua, and bulk mirrors on data.gov.ua) and the Prozorro contracting API with its free BI Prozorro analytics module, which together link an award to a signed contract, its amendments, and the actual treasury payments to a named payee. A secondary ring of aggregators (Clarity Project, Opendatabot) and oversight bodies (Рахункова палата, ДАСУ, DOZORRO) makes supplier-level lookups fast and explains anomalies that raw payment data cannot. The critical caveat for banking and payments is scope: state-owned banks such as Oschadbank and PrivatBank procure ATMs and POS terminals through Prozorro but pay outside the State Treasury, so their execution is visible in the contract register rather than in transaction feeds. The main work before collection is entity resolution — a vendor EDRPOU dictionary and a ДК 021:2015 code set — plus confirming the exact E-data API paths and any martial-law disclosure restrictions.
